name: RankPill Integration
author: rankpill

sections.description:
RankPill Integration allows you to automatically publish AI-generated articles from RankPill directly to your WordPress site.

Features:

  • Secure API key authentication
  • Automatic article publishing
  • Featured image support
  • SEO meta description integration (Yoast SEO, All in One SEO, Rank Math)
  • Post updates and republishing
  • Simple one-click setup

How It Works:

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Generate an API key from the plugin settings
  3. Connect your RankPill account using the API key
  4. Start publishing articles automatically from RankPill

Requirements:

  • Active RankPill account
  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Privacy Policy

This plugin sends article content, titles, and images to your WordPress site via the REST API when publishing from RankPill. No data is sent to third-party services except your own WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/rankpill-integration/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to RankPill in your WordPress admin menu
  4. Generate an API key
  5. Use this API key to connect your RankPill account
sections.faq:
Do I need a RankPill account?

Yes, you need an active RankPill account to use this plugin. Visit https://rankpill.com to sign up.

Is this plugin secure?

Yes. The plugin uses secure API key authentication and follows WordPress security best practices. API keys can be revoked at any time.

Can I update existing posts?

Yes. RankPill can update posts that were previously published through the integration.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

The plugin automatically integrates with Yoast SEO, All in One SEO, and Rank Math for meta descriptions.

Can I revoke an API key?

Yes. You can revoke any API key from the plugin settings page at any time.
